combine_datasets_uniform: combine multiple TensorFlow datasets into a single batched dataset with uniform sampling probability
combine_datasets_weighted: combine multiple TensorFlow datasets into a single batched dataset using custom sampling weights
combine_datasets_seeded: combine multiple TensorFlow datasets into a single batched dataset with a deterministic random seed
combine_datasets_custom_batch: combine multiple TensorFlow datasets into a single batched dataset with a custom batch size
combine_datasets_drop_remainder: combine multiple TensorFlow datasets into a single batched dataset that drops the remainder batch
